flavor: Sunlight pours through a ceiling of polished quartz, fracturing into a thousand dancing rainbows that coat the floor in shifting, iridescent colors. At the center, a pedestal of white marble holds a collection of silvered instruments and vials of liquid starlight.
name: The Prism of Refracted Grace
reason: The room serves as a non-combat reward chamber containing high-value consumable items and lore-significant artifacts.
